Synopsis:
After you sail to the other side of the Darklake, two duergar greet you. If Greymon is with you, he confirms you are a True Soul - as long as you don't mention the boots. Otherwise, the player is revealed as a True Soul through a mindmeld-type moment.there. Morghal tells you that another True Soul, Nere, is trapped above, then asks for a bribe to let you in.

Cluster Contexts:
- UND_DuergarCamp_Checkpoint.json: Your party has just landed across the Darklake and is confronted by a duergar shore party; the arrival is tense and the duergars (led by Morghal and backed by guards like Orgarth) greet you with insults and threats. Morghal says another True Soul, Nere, is trapped above and will demand a bribe/payment before he lets you investigate or gain access. If Corsair Greymon is present he will openly confirm you are a True Soul—provided you don't bring up the boots—whereas if Greymon is absent the revelation comes as a psionic, mind‑meld–type connection with Nere that is fragmented and impressionistic. Companions nearby may interject or react to the confrontation, but much of the telepathic exchange will be shards of images or emotion rather than a clear, spoken conversation.
- UND_DuergarLoyalSergeant.json: The duergar sergeant responsible for the camp while Nere is trapped. She's yelling at the gnomes and is considerably pissed off. After realising you are a True Soul, she asks you to help free Nere from the cave-in, and you can refuse or accept. You might turn in her missing boots if you have found them You can also ask about the gnome that escaped and the scrying eye.
- UND_DuergarRaftCaptain_CampIntro.json: Another duergar greets you on the other side of the lake after sailingthere with captain Greymon.Both duergar are surly, but Morghal in particular. She is suspicious of Absolutists, but happy to take their coin. She should be gruff, and absolutely not listless. She tells you that Nere is trapped above.
- UND_TheDrowNere_Mutiny.json: Dialogue after you destroy the cave-in and set Nere free. Thrinn has been put in charge of getting Nere out, but it's the player who accomplishes it. Nere almost just died from inhaling poisonous gas, so he's very angry. In this dialogue, you determine the fate of the gnomes as well as Nere and the mutinous duergar.
- SCL_Drider_Caravan_HalfOrcCaster.json: Player approaches Kansif (a stoic, honourable male half-orc) and Brawler Vez (a mouthy female goblin) after clearing a checkpoint and entering their camp in the Shadowcurse. They two Absolute cultists assume you're a True Soul sent by Minthara (which may or may not be true) and will ask if you brought the lyre needed to summon their guide through the darkness. If you have, you can play it and the drider will emerge. If you haven't, they can tell you where to find it.

context: Your party has just landed across the Darklake and is met by a surly duergar shore party led by Morghal and backed by guards like Orgarth; the arrival is tense and full of threats. Morghal says another True Soul, Nere, was trapped above by a rockfall/cave‑in and claims Nere has the gold, while the camp’s sergeant is furious and abusing gnome slaves. If Corsair Greymon is with you he will bluntly confirm you are a True Soul — but only so long as you don’t bring up the boots — whereas if Greymon is absent the revelation comes as a fragmented, mind‑meld–type psionic contact with Nere. Morghal will insist on payment (a bribe) before letting you investigate or gain access, and nearby companions may interject while much of the telepathic exchange is impressionistic rather than a clear, spoken conversation.
